text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- Agricultural organisations reject trade secretary's proposal to reduce import duties on goods from world's poorest countries. (p1)
- Computer chips industry supplier ASMI still seeks bourse launch this year. (p1)
- Mad cow disease a bonanza for Dutch pig farmers. (p1)
- Traffic and telecom minister says KPN's attempts to distance itself from its cable unit are insufficient to guarantee free competition. (p1)
- Unilever unveils plans for its subsidiary Den Hertog. (p3)
- Brewer Grolsch extends its stake in Poland's market leader Elbrewery. (p3)
- Transport and storage group Pakhoed targets higher profit level. (p4)
- Property fund Uni-Invest wants to triple its current size in five years. (p9)
VOLKSKRANT
- Entertainment group Endemol wants strong expansion in theatre sector. (p2)
- Prices of houses in the Netherlands in first nine months have risen nine percent from the same period in 1995. (p2)
- Unilever still intends to import genetically modified soybeans for its products. (p2)
- Unilever's bid for Irish tea company Lyon Irish Holdings seems set to fail. (p9)
DE TELEGRAAF
- Hunger in the Netherlands: about 20,000 families sometimes do have not enough money for food. (p1)
- Takeover of aircraft maker Fokker by Korea's Samsung is getting nearer by the day. (p3)
- Philips Electronics misses out on Egyptian order worth 300 million dollars. (p25)
- Royal Dutch Shell's U.S. unit, Shell Oil, books third quarter net profit of $504 million. (p25)
TROUW
- Decision on Maastricht airport's night flights schedule in crucial stage. (p1)
- Salt extraction company Frima opens its new production plant in Harlingen. (p7)
ALGEMEEN DAGBLAD
- Mega merger in Britains's telecom sector seems to push Dutch PTT (KPN) out of the British market. (p11)
- The Netherlands risks lagging behind new developments in the information superhighway, according to a D66 MP. (p13)
